mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GE_MP_FRMID_S A JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_S B ON A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL
AND B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}
AND B.TITL_NM LIKE '%'||#{SH_TEST_NM}||'%'
JOIN GE_MP_FRMID_M C ON B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = C.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C.FRM_ID = A.FRM_ID
AND C.FRM_ID = #{FRM_ID}
AND C.TITL_NM LIKE '%'||#{SH_TITL_NM}||'%'
JOIN GE_MP_FRM_M D ON C.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = D.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M E ON D.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = E.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL
AND E.PRCDOC_NO LIKE '%'||#{SH_PRCDOC_NO}||'%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_FRMID_S ( TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_ID, AGMST_VAL, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{FRM_ID}, #{AGMST_VAL}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, A.FRM_ID, E.PRCDOC_NM, E.PRCDOC_NO, C.TH1_ITM_NM, C.TH2_ITM_NM, C.TH3_ITM_NM, C.STDVL_VAL_NM, A.AGMST_VAL, A.REGPR_ID, A.REGPR_NM, A.RG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_FRMID_S A JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_S B ON A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL AND B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL} JOIN GE_MP_FRMID_M C ON B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = C.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C.FRM_ID = #{FRM_ID} JOIN GE_MP_FRM_M D ON C.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = D.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M E ON D.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = E.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL

SELECT B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, B.TITL_NM, E.ATCT_NM, E.APRV_YN_CFY, E.AUCR_YN, E.APRV_STEP_CFY FROM GE_MP_FRM_M A JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_S B ON A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL} JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M E ON A.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = E.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL

SELECT TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_ID, AGMST_VAL, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, MSNT_DT, TO_CHAR(RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT, TO_CHAR(MSNT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_MSNT_DT FROM GE_MP_FRMID_S WHERE 1=1 AND TST_UNQ_KY_VAL IN ( SELECT TST_UNQ_KY_VAL FROM GE_MP_CHECK_S WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = ( SELECT A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL FROM GE_MP_CHECK_S A, GE_MP_FRMID_S B WHERE A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL AND B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL} AND B.FRM_ID = #{FRM_ID} ) AND DLT_YN = 'N' ) AND FRM_ID = #{FRM_ID} ORDER BY MSNT_DT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_FRMMNT_S ( UNQ_KY_VAL, TST_UNQ_KY_VAL, UNQ_ID, CHCK_YN, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT, RMK_NM ) VALUES ( #{UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{UNQ_ID}, #{CHCK_YN}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE, #{RMK_NM} )
mapper.select:
SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(CHCK_STRT_DT, '(.{4})(.{2})(.{2})','\1-\2-\3') || ' ~ ' || REGEXP_REPLACE(CHCK_END_DT, '(.{4})(.{2})(.{2})','\1-\2-\3') AS "시험기간", C.PRCDOC_NO AS "절차서번호", C.PRCDOC_NM AS "절차서명",
A.TITL_NM AS "시험명", A.CHKPR_FNM AS "점검자", CASE WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'R' THEN '준비' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'A' THEN '허가' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'F' THEN '수행' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'S' THEN '정지' WHEN A.PRSTS_CFY = 'C' THEN '완료' ELSE '' END AS "상태", A.REGPR_NM AS "등록자", TO_CHAR(A.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "등록일"
C.ATCT_NM AS "점검지명", A.TITL_NM AS "점검명", A.CHKPR_FNM AS "점검자", A.REGPR_NM AS "등록자", TO_CHAR(A.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "등록일"
FROM GE_MP_CHECK_S A JOIN GE_MP_FRM_M B ON A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M C ON B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = C.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL
AND C.PRCDOC_CFY = #{PRCDOC_CFY}
AND C.PRCDOC_NO LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NO}||'%'
AND C.PRCDOC_NM LIKE '%'||#{PRCDOC_NM}||'%'
WHERE A.DLT_YN = 'N'
AND A.CHCK_STRT_DT >= #{CHCK_STRT_DT}
AND A.CHCK_END_DT <= #{CHCK_END_DT}
AND A.PRSTS_CFY = #{PRSTS_CFY}
AND A.PRSTS_CFY IN (${PRSTS_CFY_M})
AND A.TITL_NM LIKE '%'||#{TITL_NM}||'%'
ORDER BY A.CHCK_STRT_DT DESC, A.RG_DT DESC
ORDER BY A.RG_DT DESC, A.CHCK_STRT_DT DESC

SELECT E.PRCDOC_NO AS "절차서번호", B.TITL_NM AS "시험명", C.TITL_NM AS "제목명", C.TH1_ITM_NM ||' '|| C.TH2_ITM_NM ||' '|| C.TH3_ITM_NM AS "분류", A.AGMST_VAL AS "기록값", A.REGPR_NM AS "기록자", TO_CHAR(A.MSNT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "기록일시" FROM GE_MP_FRMID_S A JOIN GE_MP_CHECK_S B ON A.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL
AND B.TST_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{TST_UNQ_KY_VAL}
AND B.TITL_NM LIKE '%'||#{SH_TEST_NM}||'%'
JOIN GE_MP_FRMID_M C ON B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = C.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND C.FRM_ID = A.FRM_ID
AND C.FRM_ID = #{FRM_ID}
AND C.TITL_NM LIKE '%'||#{SH_TITL_NM}||'%'
JOIN GE_MP_FRM_M D ON C.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = D.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M E ON D.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = E.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL
AND E.PRCDOC_NO LIKE '%'||#{SH_PRCDOC_NO}||'%'
ORDER BY MSNT_DT DESC
